verdict.rationale: Warp's privacy docs say users can opt out of telemetry at any time, publish the full list of telemetry events, and let users watch telemetry live in a native Network Log. Business and Enterprise plans add Zero Data Retention, and admins get org-wide privacy controls. The main caveat for an AI-native user is that Free-plan users must keep telemetry on to use AI features; only paid plans can opt out and keep AI. Community feedback confirms telemetry is on by default (opt-out) and that proactive AI suggestions can be turned off in settings. missing for 10: telemetry opt-out that keeps AI features on the Free plan, opt-out-by-default (opt-in) telemetry, independent hands-on confirmation that opting out stops all tracking
